facts.fact: Xalam's July 2025 brief says the Zimbabwean data centre market includes facilities managed by state-owned TelOne, offering colocation to third parties; it does not name the facilities individually.

systems.owner: State presence (described as Huawei-built; ownership not otherwise stated)

note: Owner fact for TelOne-managed facilities only; the national data centre's owner is not stated and the migration of government applications to it is described as a push, so no state fact.
